h: DJ Cuppy meets Queen Camilla at Buckingham Palace
p: DJ Cuppy has reportedly met Queen Camilla at Buckingham Palace, greeting her with a curtsy and a handshake. A video of the brief encounter has drawn mixed reactions online.
body: Nigerian DJ and singer Cuppy has got fans talking after a video showed her meeting Queen Camilla at Buckingham Palace in London.

The video was filmed on Monday, 23 November 2026. Cuppy, whose real name is Florence Otedola, is seen greeting the Queen with a slight curtsy and a handshake before the two chat briefly. Queen Camilla then moved on to greet other guests at the event.
The clip spread quickly online, drawing a range of reactions from Nigerians, with people commenting on her curtsy, her outfit and the significance of the moment.
more: Cuppy greeted the Queen with a curtsy and a handshake.
The meeting took place at Buckingham Palace.
The video has drawn mixed reactions.
